Fist Creekrider is a dwarven cleric and a member of the Flaming Fist. He can be found in Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.
“
So, what? You're saying there could really be a dragon down there?
„
— Creekrider, discussing prisoner's slumber-mutters

Involvement

Creekrider guards the Wyrm's Rock Prison together with  Fist Saunder,  Fist Jagic and  Fist Ivarus. While the latter is constantly patrolling the prison corridor, Creekrider sits in a guardroom with the other two Fists, wagging their tongues around recent events in the fortress: the death sentence passed on  Counsellor Florrick,  Gortash's ordaining, occasional thefts in the Flaming Fist barracks and some others. Creekrider does not want to discuss any of these with the player character, reacting to attempts to speak with him with grunts only.

If Gortash is defeated, Creekrider takes the news philosophically, suggesting that he will carry on his duties regardless.
